newsitem.title: USA: PHLX, CBOE to list new options in next week.
newsitem.headline: PHLX, CBOE to list new options in next week.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) and the Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Monday they would each ist two options within the next week.

The PHLX said it would list options on Lone Star Technologies Inc and Titanium Metals Corp on December 4. The CBOE said it would list Abacan Resource Corp and Canadian National Railway Co options on December 9.
Lone Star options will have opening strike prices of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with initial expirations in December, January, February and May. Group One Ltd will be the specialist.
For Titanium Metals, opening strikes will be at 30, 35 and 40 and initial expirations in December, January, April and July. G-Bar Ltd will be the specialist.

On the CBOE, Abacan Resource options will have opening strikes of five, 7-1/2 and 10 and initial expirations in January, February, April and July. Saliba Partners has been named Designated Primary Market Maker (DPM).

Options on Canadian National Railway will open with strike prices of 35, 40 and 45 and expirations in January, February, April and July. OTA Ltd Partnership is the DPM. ((Derivatives desk,3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
